name: Мат турою і слоном
description:
In this lesson you will learn to make checkmate with a rook and a bishop. This only works if these team up.

You can never checkmate with a rook and bishop alone. But it does work if black, for example, has pawns on the board.

Take a look at the examples.

 

 

What do you have do?

Checkmate the king with your rook and bishop.

examples.text: This is a checkmate from close by. The rook attacks the king and the bishop protects the rook.

Now a mate from a distance. The rook attacks the king and the bishop ensures that the king cannot escape.

This mating pattern has a name: Greco's mat.
Here the roles of the bishop and rook are reversed. Now the bishop attacks the king and the rook removes the king's flight squares.

texts: Checkmate in 1 move! Use the coordination between your rook and bishop.
